objective: Rebuild INGEST as a three-decision flow — WHERE it goes, HOW it arrives, WHICH batch — with a state-derived stage strip and a real batch lifecycle. Clear the stale active batch correctly.
what_changed_from_the_mockup: Destination selection added as the FIRST decision. It was missing entirely and it is not cosmetic: destination changes the commit contract.
Method selection expanded from three tiles to a real method registry (scanner, UPC, manual, image upload, CSV, API import).
Stage strip becomes derived state. In the mockup it was decorative.
Batch lifecycle and a recent/active batch panel with lookup added.

hard_stops.trigger: Any code path deletes a batch, or deletes or mutates a raw scan.
hard_stops.action: STOP. Raw scans are immutable. Closing a batch is a STATUS CHANGE, never a delete. There is no destructive batch action anywhere in this feature.

hard_stops.trigger: An ingested row is stored without its ingest_method, or the method is inferred at read time.
hard_stops.action: STOP. Method is provenance. A UPC scan and a manual entry are different evidence classes and must stay distinguishable forever.

hard_stops.trigger: A seeded, demo, or fixture batch can render in a non-fixture environment.
hard_stops.action: STOP. Add an environment guard. The current stale batch exists because nothing prevented this.

hard_stops.trigger: A UPC scan sets condition, grade, or printing-level identity.
hard_stops.action: STOP. A UPC identifies a SKU. It cannot distinguish printings, reprint waves, or condition. Anything beyond product identity must come from another method or a human.

hard_stops.trigger: Commit runs a single shared path that ignores destination.
hard_stops.action: STOP. Dealer inventory, personal collection, binder slots, and hunt targets have different required fields. See destination_contract.

hard_stops.trigger: A design decision is needed that the GATES do not cover.
hard_stops.action: STOP. Report the decision, the options, and your recommendation.

gates.name: The stale Ricoh batch
gates.status: RESOLVED — branch on what it is
gates.resolution: FIRST determine whether it holds real raw scans. If it does: set status to 'abandoned' via the lifecycle, preserve every scan, and report the scan count. If it is seed or demo data: delete the seed and add the HS-3 environment guard. Report which case it was. Do not guess — check for linked raw scan rows.

gates.name: Destination taxonomy
gates.resolution: Reuse the buckets that already exist in vault_collection rather than inventing new ones. Expected set: Personal Collection, Dealer Inventory, Investment, plus sub-targets Binder and Hunt. Read the schema and report what is actually there before wiring the selector.

gates.name: UPC to priced_unit mapping table
gates.resolution: Create it in the CATALOG layer, not in ingest and not in market. Store GTIN normalized to 14 digits, zero-padded, as varchar. Never numeric. Include: gtin14, priced_unit_id (nullable until confirmed), confirmed_by, confirmed_at, source_url, source_tier, needs_review. Name and exact schema placement flagged for Greg in the ADR.

gates.name: API import sources
gates.resolution: Render the method tile in a disabled state reading 'No sources connected'. Do NOT build a stub that appears to work. An import method that silently does nothing is worse than one that is visibly unavailable.

gates.name: CSV presets
gates.resolution: Build a column-mapping step with saved presets. Ship two: CLZ XML/CSV and Collectr CSV. Both are already in use. A preset is data, not code.

step_1_destination.question: Where is this inventory going?
step_1_destination.note: First decision, always. Cannot be skipped, cannot be changed mid-batch — a batch belongs to one destination. Changing destination means a new batch.
step_1_destination.sub_target: Some destinations take an optional sub-target: a specific binder, a specific hunt, a dealer intake lot.

step_2_method.question: How is it arriving?

methods.label: Scanner (live)
methods.notes: HID keyboard mode. Capture field holds focus, Enter commits a row and re-focuses. This is the default for sealed product.

methods.label: Scanner (stored upload)
methods.notes: Accepts a paste dump from the scanner's Storage Mode. One code per line. Same validation path as live.

methods.label: Card images
methods.notes: CardSight path. Front and back. Carries the false-auto-confirm metric.

methods.label: Manual entry
methods.notes: Typed by a human. NOT the same as verified — it is asserted, and stays distinguishable from device capture.

methods.label: CSV / file import
methods.notes: Column mapping step with presets. See G-5.

step_2_method.rule: The method's evidence_class is written to every row it produces and never recomputed.

step_3_batch.question: New batch, or continue an existing one?
step_3_batch.panel: Recent and active batches, searchable by name, date, destination, method, and status. Each row shows: name, destination, method, counts (captured / identified / review / unresolved), status, last activity.

destination_contract.note: Destination changes what commit requires. This is why a shared commit path is HS-5.
destination_contract.personal_collection: Requires product identity. Condition optional but prompts. May target a binder slot.
destination_contract.dealer_inventory: Requires cost basis and quantity. Surfaces margin and listing readiness at commit.
destination_contract.investment: Requires cost basis and acquisition date. Cost basis is not optional here.
destination_contract.binder: Requires a resolved slot. A commit that cannot resolve a slot goes to review, not to the binder.
destination_contract.hunt: Commit updates hunt completion. A duplicate against an already-filled hunt slot must surface as a duplicate, not silently increment.

rules: Raw scans persist across every state, including abandoned.
abandoned is reversible to active. committed is terminal.
Only one batch per destination may be 'active' at a time; starting another pauses the first with a visible notice.
A batch older than 30 days with no activity renders as stale in the panel but is never auto-abandoned. Ask, never assume.

stage_strip.rule: Derived from batch counters. Never manually advanced, never decorative.

derivation.capture: active while items are still arriving
derivation.commit: enabled when review reaches 0, or when the user explicitly chooses partial commit

stage_strip.note: In the current build this strip does nothing. That is the bug being fixed here — it must read real state or be removed.

capture_field_requirements: Autofocus on mount; re-focus after every committed row. A scanner types into whatever has focus and will eventually type into the wrong thing.
Validate the GTIN mod-10 check digit on entry. Reject with a visible reason, never silently.
Normalize to GTIN-14, zero-padded, stored as varchar.
Known GTIN resolves from the mapping table and increments quantity rather than erroring on duplicate.
Unknown GTIN opens an INLINE confirm row — never a modal. A modal breaks the scanning rhythm and the operator is holding a scanner, not a mouse.
Running count always visible, so a missed scan is distinguishable from a slow one.
Paste-many input accepts a Storage Mode dump, one code per line, through the same validation path.
A product resolved less than 90 days from release is flagged thin-comps at commit. New releases have no comp history by definition.
required_states: No destination chosen yet — method and batch steps not reachable.
Destination chosen, no active batch — new batch prompt.
Active batch mid-capture with live rows appearing.
Failed checksum with a visible reason.
A batch with review items blocking commit.
Partial commit with review items remaining.
An abandoned batch in the panel, showing its preserved scan count.
A stale batch older than 30 days.
API import method, disabled and honest about it.
CSV import at the column-mapping step with a preset applied.

phases.name: Diagnose and clear the stale batch
tasks: Determine whether the existing active batch has linked raw scans. Report the count.
Apply G-1: abandon it, or delete the seed and add the environment guard.
Report which case it was.

phases.name: Batch lifecycle
tasks: States, transitions, one-active-per-destination rule.
No destructive action anywhere. HS-1.

phases.name: Destination step
tasks: Read vault_collection and report the real buckets (G-2).
Selector with sub-target support.
Destination is immutable for the life of a batch.

phases.name: Method registry
tasks: Methods as config with evidence_class attached.
api_import disabled per G-4.
evidence_class written to every produced row.

phases.name: Batch panel
tasks: Recent and active list with search across name, date, destination, method, status.
Counts per batch. Stale marker. Resume and abandon actions.

phases.name: Stage strip, derived
tasks: Wire to real counters. Remove every hardcoded stage value.

phases.name: GTIN capture path
tasks: Capture field per capture_field_requirements.
Checksum, normalization, duplicate handling, inline unknown-GTIN confirm.
Paste-many for Storage Mode dumps.

phases.name: GTIN mapping table
tasks: Migration per G-3, date-prefixed, transaction-wrapped.
varchar GTIN-14. Never numeric. needs_review never auto-cleared.

phases.name: CSV import
tasks: Column mapper with CLZ and Collectr presets.
Dedup against existing inventory before commit.

phases.name: Commit paths
tasks: Per-destination commit per destination_contract.
Partial commit leaves review items in the batch, never drops them.

phases.name: ADR + report
tasks: docs/adr/0015-ingest-flow.md.
Report: what the stale batch turned out to be, gates left open, and what you would have done differently but did not.

parked.reason: The lookup method is proven manually but needs a source-tier policy before automating. Inline confirm accepts a typed product for now.
Interfaces only. The image methods render and queue; identification itself is not built here.
Field modes are a separate workstream.

definition_of_done: No active batch exists that nobody created.
No code path can delete a raw scan — enforced by a test.
Stage strip reflects real counters under every required state.
Every ingested row carries its ingest_method and evidence_class.
GTIN stored as varchar, normalized to 14, checksum-validated on entry.
Every entry in required_states has a rendered case.
ADR 0015 written and the report delivered.
